sql:
select lo.strategy, lo.status, count(*) n, max(lo.created_at) last_at,
 sum(case when m.status is null or m.status not in ('settled','finalized','determined','closed') then 1 else 0 end) on_unsettled_mkts,
 string_agg(distinct case when m.status is null or m.status not in ('settled','finalized','determined','closed') then lo.market_ticker||'('||coalesce(m.status,'?')||')' end, ' ') unsettled
from live_orders lo left join markets m on m.ticker=lo.market_ticker
where lo.strategy in ('Cmmsell10','Dmmsell10','Fmmsell10','Jmmsell10','Kmmsell10','Nmmsell10','Vmmsell10')
group by lo.strategy, lo.status order by lo.strategy, lo.status
